title: Tamarack Precision Components: Deepfaked CFO and Urgent Wires
summary: A Greenville, South Carolina manufacturer's finance, security, legal and communications teams and their simulated payment, AI incident and executive-verification plans, with an exercise generated from them: a deepfaked video meeting with the CFO and General Counsel drives four urgent wires while the real CFO is on a flight, then a fake CEO video reaches the press.
notice: EXERCISE MATERIAL — for training use. Tamarack Precision Components, its banks, vendors, people and amounts are simulated; the public sources consulted for realism are listed in reference/tamarack-ai-fraud/SOURCES.md. Synthetic media in this exercise is fictional, carries a transcript and a text description, and depicts no real person.

scenarios.title: Escrow Echo
scenarios.summary: On a Tuesday morning in September a Tamarack treasury analyst joins a video meeting with what appears to be the CFO and the General Counsel and is told to wire money for a secret acquisition; four wires totaling $2.64 million are requested while the real CFO is unreachable on a flight, and by afternoon a fake CEO video is on social media and in a reporter's inbox.
